questionText: If structure classification is subjective, what is being replayed when MOGO tests it?
reason: This source states plainly that two traders may classify the same chart differently and neither is wrong. That is an honest and unusual admission - no other source in the library concedes it - and it has a direct consequence for replay: a mechanical implementation tests ONE reading, not 'the method'. Any replay result must be reported with the swing-detection parameters it assumed.
